equity.level_reason: Coverage by county SVI tertile is reported and interpreted (lowest in most vulnerable counties, attributed to access and cost barriers), but values are only set side by side with a CI-overlap rule and no computed difference or ratio, so the cap at 2 applies.

level_alternative.reason: An area index stratifier with an interpreted gradient and named determinants (vaccine access, cost and payment barriers from commercialization) could read as a quantified, explained disparity.

Influenza vaccination coverage was highest in the least socially vulnerable counties (73.7%) and lowest in the most socially vulnerable counties (70.9%).

notes: Representativeness of voluntary influenza and RSV reporters was judged by setting facility distributions side by side (no test). NIS coverage figures in the Discussion are cited external estimates, not analyzed. The Poisson model's covariates are not stated; it is read as covariate-free per-stratum estimation.
view_issues: Prepass 'p_value' cue is only the α = 0.05 in the CI-overlap rule; 'prevalence_ratio' cue is a false hit (PR = Puerto Rico).
